end.summary:
Discussed physical and chemical changes using cooking and state-change examples.
Ananya identified softening noodles, melting ice cream, and melting ghee as physical changes.
Ananya identified new colour and smell as clues to a possible chemical change.
Teach-back was not passed; the final heat-and-light rule was not checked further.
end.parentNote: Asha practised distinguishing physical changes by looking for changes in state, shape, or size, and chemical changes by noticing new colour or smell. Ananya correctly classified several melting examples and later added that melted ghee can become solid again on cooling. There was a mix-up when heat and light were treated as a complete rule for chemical change; this was not corrected after the last response. At home, ask Ananya to sort everyday examples into physical or chemical change and explain whether a new substance forms.
